lead: Multiple servers, messages, threads and files in a dedicated application.
serversText: Switch between Mattermost servers. Sign in with a username and password, or through GitLab when your server supports it.
messagesText: Read history, reply in threads, find messages and keep drafts. Resize the panels while the feed stays in place.
filesText: Preview images, PDF, text, Markdown, audio and video. Download attachments and add files to your messages.
demo: Application screenshots from a demonstration server. Conversations contain fictional data.
noRelease: Packaged releases have not been published yet. You can build the client from source.
unavailable: Could not load releases. Open GitHub Releases.
platforms: System WebViews instead of Electron. Linux, Windows and macOS.
authorText: The project is licensed under Apache License 2.0. Author: Pavel Simonov / Sipaha.
appLanguages: The application interface is available in Russian and English.
title: SPK MM Client. A desktop client for Mattermost
description: Multiple servers, messages, threads and files in a dedicated application.
